choices.why: No green velvet sofa is offered, so this classic rolled-arm three-seater in dark charcoal with black turned legs is the closest deep, elegant tone and matches the black mantel.
A pair of stately oatmeal wingback chairs facing each other gives the classic fireside look and lightens the dark sofa and rug.
This large traditional medallion wool rug is big enough to anchor the whole seating group, and its charcoal and ivory tones tie the sofa and chairs together.
This dark walnut table with a molded-edge top and trestle base is a classic, well-proportioned centerpiece between the sofa and the fireplace.
This large champagne-gold traditional mirror suits the chimney breast and brings elegant light and warmth against the pale blue-green walls.
Its pleated fabric empire shade and slender stem give the classic, elegant fabric-shade lamp requested.

answer.why: A charcoal sofa, oatmeal wingbacks, a medallion rug, dark wood and a gold mirror form a timeless classic fireside group that respects the room's moldings, coffered ceiling and dark mantel. The green velvet the user asked for isn't in the catalog, so the sofa uses the closest deep charcoal tone instead.
